prompt: A student checks if two strings are equal but the result is always false. What's wrong?
choices: Strings cannot be compared with if
Should use a.equals(b) instead of a == b
"hello" is not a valid String literal
The condition needs parentheses around a == b
explanation: == on String objects checks reference equality (same object in memory), not content. a and b are different objects even though they contain the same text. Use a.equals(b) or a.equalsIgnoreCase(b).
